name: career-autopilot
description: AI job-application assistant. Jobs are real & verified-only (structured sources + server-side URL verification, NO AI-generated jobs). AI returns only structured resume JSON; PDF/DOCX/TXT/LaTeX layout is produced by separate template renderers rendering real data only. v3.3 ships 8 visually-distinct resume templates by length — single-page: Modern Blue Sidebar, Executive Clean, Jake Tech Compact, ATS Compact Classic; multi-page: Modern Professional, ATS Detailed, Technical Detailed, Project Heavy Detailed — with an Auto/Single/Multi length selector and role-based recommendations. Job sources: balanced multi-source discovery with LinkedIn, Indeed, Naukri, Foundit, Wellfound, Instahyre, Cutshort, Hirist, Shine and TimesJobs through SerpAPI/JSearch when keys are set, plus Adzuna/USAJobs optional APIs and public fallback APIs The Muse, Arbeitnow, Jobicy, Remotive and RemoteOK.
